_what: Modals whose body switches on something but does NOT need a floor under it, each with the reason. Enforced by modal-steady-height.test.ts. A modal that genuinely changes what it shows belongs in SteadyHeight (or one of the other two holders), not here — this list is for bodies the scan reads as multi-view and that are not.

noViewsOfItsOwn.src/features/dashboard/ui/aiSurface/comp: Its two modes change the TITLE and which field takes focus. The body is one form either way, so there is no second height to jump to.
